summary: Warehouse Module Testing - 30 test cases. Backend: 31/31 pytest tests PASSED (100%). Frontend: All 5 tabs verified working (Dashboard, Stock, Movements, Transfers, Performance). All warehouse features working correctly.

WH-01.notes: GET /api/analytics/warehouse/stock returns items with sku, warehouse, quantity, style, size fields

WH-05.notes: Stock table includes mrp and stock_value columns. totals.total_value=570924507.0 > 0

WH-06.notes: totals.low_stock=686 (qty < reorder_point=50). Frontend Low Stock KPI card is clickable and filters table

WH-07.notes: totals.out_of_stock=14 (qty = 0). Frontend shows Out of Stock KPI card

WH-08.notes: totals.overstock=0 (qty > max_threshold=500). Frontend shows Overstock KPI card

WH-09.notes: GET /api/analytics/warehouse/movements returns inbound items with direction='inbound', source, reference. summary.total_inbound=48.1K

WH-10.notes: GET /api/analytics/warehouse/movements returns outbound items with direction='outbound', destination, reference. summary.total_outbound=13.8K

WH-11.notes: Movements array has timestamp field, creating timeline view in frontend

WH-12.notes: GET /api/analytics/warehouse/daily-change returns days array with opening_stock, closing_stock, change fields

WH-13.notes: GET /api/analytics/warehouse/reconciliation returns reconciliations with system_qty, physical_qty, variance. POST creates new reconciliation

WH-14.notes: GET /api/analytics/warehouse/adjustments returns adjustments with previous_qty, new_qty, change, reason, adjusted_by fields

WH-15.notes: POST /api/analytics/warehouse/transfers creates new transfer with from_warehouse, to_store, items, status=pending

WH-16.notes: PUT /api/analytics/warehouse/transfers/{id}/allocate changes status from pending to allocated

WH-17.notes: PUT /api/analytics/warehouse/transfers/{id}/approve changes status from allocated to approved with approved_by field

WH-18.notes: GET /api/analytics/warehouse/transfers/in-transit returns transfers with status=in_transit and total_in_transit=87

WH-19.notes: PUT /api/analytics/warehouse/transfers/{id}/receive changes status from in_transit to received with received_by

WH-20.notes: GET /api/analytics/warehouse/transfers/history returns full audit trail of all transfers (15 total)

WH-24.notes: GET /api/analytics/warehouse/performance returns utilization_pct=102.1% and by_warehouse array with capacity and utilization_pct

WH-25.notes: GET /api/analytics/warehouse/performance returns slow_moving array (1 SKU with no sales in 90+ days)

WH-26.notes: GET /api/analytics/warehouse/dashboard returns kpis with total_stock=306.4K, total_value=$5709.2L, total_skus=2.3K, total_warehouses=3, snapshot_date=2026-03-31

WH-27.notes: GET /api/analytics/warehouse/dashboard returns category_chart array. Frontend shows Stock by Category bar chart (Pants)

WH-28.notes: GET /api/analytics/warehouse/dashboard returns movement_trend with inbound/outbound per day. Frontend shows line chart

WH-29.notes: Frontend Stock tab has Export CSV button that downloads warehouse_stock_2026-04-03.csv

WH-30.notes: GET /api/analytics/warehouse/dashboard returns comparison array with warehouse, total_qty, stock_value, sku_count. Frontend shows side-by-side comparison table

critical_code_review_comments: Backend endpoints properly structured under /api/analytics/warehouse/* prefix
Stock data comes from uploaded_files collection (warehouse_inventory, sku_ean_master, style_master)
Warehouse names: Central WH, North WH, South WH
Transfer lifecycle: pending → allocated → approved → in_transit → received
Frontend has 5 tabs: Dashboard, Stock, Movements, Transfers, Performance
